title: Ian Fleming airport (OCJ): how to reach your hotel

lines.text: Flying into Jamaica's north coast at Ian Fleming? Here's how to reach your hotel.
The airport is in Boscobel, Saint Mary, about fifteen kilometres east of Ocho Rios.
The airport lists taxi or coach hire, and taxis are available on site when needed, for an extra fee.
Or book a private transfer before you land, so your driver is arranged in advance.
Driving yourself? Jamaica drives on the left, so take it slowly on the coast road.
